[[No overall control]]{{efn|Labour/Green/Liberal Democrats coalition.}} | after_election = TBD | after_party = [[No overall control]] }} The '''2026 Havant Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 12 of 36 members of [[Havant Borough Council]] in [[Hampshire]], [[England]].{{Cite web|title=Current and Future Elections {{!}} Havant Borough Council|url=https://www.havant.gov.uk/elections/current-and-future-elections|website=www.havant.gov.uk|access-date=2026-01-30}} Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this will be the final election to Havant Borough Council before it is abolished and replaced by a successor [[unitary authority]]. Elections to the successor authority are due to take place in 2027. ==Summary== === Background === In [[2024 Havant Borough Council election|2024]], the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] lost the council to [[no overall control]].{{Cite news|title=Havant result - Local Elections 2024|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E07000090|work=BBC News|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}}{{Cite web|title=Massive shock as Conservatives lose Havant Borough Council - full list of results|url=https://www.portsmouth.co.uk/news/politics/havant-borough-council-election-results-2024-4616248|website=The News|date=2024-05-03|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}} === Council composition === {| class="wikitable" |- ! colspan="3" | After 2024 election ! colspan="3" | Before 2026 election |- ! colspan="2" | Party !
